visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged man with short black hair wearing a white t-shirt with a cartoon graphic stands in a brightly lit indoor food court area. He faces the camera, speaking and gesturing with both hands. In the background, shoppers and diners are visible sitting at white tables. (2) A close-up shot focuses on a menu board above a service counter, specifically highlighting 'Braised Pork Rice w/ Radish Soup' priced at 99 NTD, with surrounding items partially visible. (3) The man is now seated at a white food court table. He uses his hands to remove a plastic lid from a white paper bowl containing braised pork and rice. A cup with a red and white pattern is beside the bowl. (4) Extreme close-ups show the glistening fat and meat of the braised pork and the texture of the pickled mustard greens as the man lifts a portion with a fork. (5) The man eats the food and drinks from the cup, displaying expressive facial reactions. Graphic flame overlays appear on screen as he reacts to the heat of the soup. He continues to talk to the camera while holding the cup and spoon.
